scope: PTC strategy and output templates, not execution engine or sandbox
protectedPolicy: SDK loading is effective next step. Preserve revisions, result completeness, errors and effect/retry facts. Never bypass permissions. Do not retry unknown write effects. ops_batch supports copy/move/remove only.

template.initial: For multi-step work, use available PTC APIs for loops, filtering and aggregation. Print only task-relevant rows, paths, revisions, coverage and error/effect facts. Check status before extracting data. Stop or inspect ambiguous side effects. Do not serialize whole intermediate objects by default.

threshold.initial: Use native calls for simple one- or two-step tasks.
values: Use native calls for simple one- or two-step tasks.
Use PTC only when repeated processing outweighs SDK/code overhead.
